headlines.title: Western Digital Stock Has Nearly Halved—and Earnings Could Spark a Comeback
headlines.summary: Western Digital’s pricing power and outlook will be in focus as investors assess whether the hard-drive market’s upswing can continue.

headlines.title: Western Digital (WDC) Stock Gets Fair Value Trim As Analysts Weigh HDD Demand And HAMR Risks
headlines.summary: Western Digital’s modeled fair value has been nudged lower, shifting from US$664.92 to US$650.67 in the latest update. Analysts link this adjustment to a more balanced view that mixes confidence in hard disk drive demand and AI related storage needs with questions around execution, technology transitions, and potential supply growth from rivals.

headlines.title: BofA lifts Western Digital target despite lower capacity outlook
headlines.summary: Tight hard-drive supply is keeping prices high as BofA raises its target to $800 ahead of earnings.

headlines.title: What Is Western Digital (WDC) Asking After Unauthorized Tokenized Share Trading?
headlines.summary: Western Digital (NasdaqGS:WDC) has objected to tokenized versions of its shares trading on the OKX-ICE digital asset platform. The data storage group has raised concerns that its equity is being referenced and traded in token form without authorization. Western Digital's pushback follows similar objections from other large issuers as tokenized securities experiments draw more regulatory attention.

headlines.title: Western Digital, Nova, Amtech, Monolithic Power Systems, and Texas Instruments shares skyrocket, what you need to know
headlines.summary: A number of stocks jumped in the afternoon session after strong demand for artificial intelligence hardware and robust corporate earnings reignited investor optimism across the broader AI technology landscape.

description: Western Digital Corporation engages in the development, manufacture, and sale of data storage devices and solutions based on hard disk drive (HDD) technology in the United States, Asia, Europe, the Middle East, and Africa. The company offers internal HDDs, data center drives, data center platforms, external drives, portable drives, NAS for home and office, and accessories. It sells its data storage devices and solutions through its computer sales personnel, dealers, distributors, retailers, and subsidiaries. The company has a collaboration with Open Quantum Design for the development of quantum error correction technology and related systems to advance reliable quantum computing. Western Digital Corporation was founded in 1970 and is headquartered in San Jose, California.
